mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zzl_ai_document_chunk (chunk_id, file_id, scope, conversation_id, source_name, chunk_index, start_offset, end_offset, content, keywords, embedding, embedding_model, created_at) VALUES (#{chunkId}, #{fileId}, #{scope}, COALESCE(#{conversationId}, ''), #{sourceName}, #{chunkIndex}, #{startOffset}, #{endOffset}, #{content}, COALESCE(#{keywords}, ''), COALESCE(#{embedding}, ''), COALESCE(#{embeddingModel}, ''), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM zzl_ai_document_chunk WHERE scope = #{scope} AND file_id = #{fileId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM zzl_ai_document_chunk WHERE scope = #{scope} AND chunk_id IN #{chunkId}
